auditScope: Complete hierarchy screen of 62 series and 3239 file units
methodology: Chronology candidates require direct, selective, or boundary relevance plus a Catalog or title-supported date between 1989 and 1992. Folder-level candidates remain archival locators until a document is selected and its heading, dateline, extent, release state, terminal markings, and controlling copy are checked in the source images.
